results.title: Don Juicy
results.overview: Jorge and his son Emil were supposed to be guests at his boss's birthday party, but when they unexpectedly have to fill in as waiters, they are dragged into their host's juicy scheme. Now Emil fights the role of the mascot, while Jorge senses an opportunity for career advancement. A story about sweat, (post-)migrant experiences, family and guacamole. ¡Ay Caramba!

results.title: CONFERENCE
results.overview: At once minimal and maximal, the latest experiment from Austrian formalist Björn Kämmerer recasts elements as simple as a campfire and three seated men into a paranoid play of gazes, variously suggesting assent and discordance.

results.title: Legends from the Past
results.overview: On assignment from the editorial office a reporter from Yekaterinburg goes to a village lost in taiga, where he hears an ancient legend about the lord of the forest. Upon his return home all of a sudden he starts seeing and hearing the ancient spirit who begs him to save the endangered fantastic creatures. The reporter agrees and in the company of his 12-year-old daughter, who has come from Moscow to spend the vacation with him, he sets off for the lands virtually untouched by civilization. The trip filled with unexpected adventures, will bring the father and daughter closer together because it’s only together that they will be able to solve the mystery of the ancient legends from the past.

results.title: Snoop's Holiday Halftime Party
results.overview: Snoop Dogg and his merry friends sleigh through Minnesota on NFL Gameday to deliver a special holiday performance.

results.title: Yorushika LIVE 2024 [ZENSE]
results.overview: A man and woman, now living apart, reunite after a long time. They sit on a bench in the shade of the trees and talk. The man speaks in a tone like he's talking to himself, about strange dreams he's been having often lately. "In some of them, I'm an animal,  a plant, a tree, and a human." Even though it's a dream, it feels vividly real, as if he's become that thing. “Yeah, that's what it is... a previous life.”

results.title: Dropbear
results.overview: A group of US tourists on a cheap Aussie outback tour discover the scam's fake dropbear attack has led them into the lair of a real, flesh-hungry koala king and his rabid army.

results.title: So Long
results.overview: Within the fading echoes of their once-intimate bond, a long-time married couple parts ways with the familiar comforts of their home and the memories it holds, into the final chapter of life.

results.title: Sacramento
results.overview: When free-spirited Rickey suddenly reappears in father-to-be Glenn’s life, the two former best friends embark on a spontaneous road trip from LA to Sacramento.

results.title: Homecam
results.overview: Single mother Sung-hee moves into a new apartment and installs a homecam to protect her sick daughter, Ji-woo. She also hires a babysitter. While closing a suicide case at her insurance job, Sung-hee hears an eerie, ritualistic chant in the recorded footage. Soon after, she begins to witness a mysterious woman and Ji-woo's strange behavior on the homecam. As she digs deeper into the case, an unseen force begins to close in on her. Su-rim, a shaman living downstairs, suggests performing an exorcism ritual.

results.title: Bunker
results.overview: It charts the fallout when a nuclear threat forces six people into a malfunctioning underground bunker. Tensions soon rise as they fight to stay alive. With oxygen and the trust in each other quickly running out, they learn that a more sinister plan is afoot

results.title: Monster in the Family: The Stacey Kananen Story
results.original_title: Monster in the Family: The Stacey Kananen Story
results.overview: Stacey survives a childhood of abuse and fear, only to face a shocking twist when her brother Rickie confesses to her that he killed their parents. She is further betrayed when Rickie claims she helped him commit the crimes.

results.title: American Pizza | A 48 Hour Film
results.overview: While attempting to make a film in under 48 hours, a group of young filmmakers decide to prank the pizza delivery guy with a fake corpse.

results.title: 2025 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony
results.original_title: 2025 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony
results.overview: On Saturday, November 8, 2025, rock royalty once again gathered to celebrate the induction of another class of performers, influencers and excellent musicians into the Hallowed Hall of Rock. The 2025 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees were Bad Company, Chubby Checker, Joe Cocker, Cyndi Lauper, Outkast, Soundgarden and The White Stripes in the Performer category.

results.title: Robot Girlfriend: Revenge
results.overview: A robot girlfriend begins to have murderous impulses when she discovers feelings of love.

results.title: Hang-Up
results.overview: Maddie enters a phone carrier store to replace her phone number but the decision to delete her history proves to be a challenge.

results.title: Cənnət yuxusu
results.overview: Dedicated to the 200th anniversary of the birth of Mirza Gadim Iravani, an Azerbaijani portraitist and ornamentalist painter, the founder of easel painting - his life and work, as well as the historical and cultural heritage of the ancient city of Yerevan.

results.title: Woodwards
results.overview: A young woman struggles with living a life wherein her identity is still tied to the abuse she experienced as a child. One night, she falls victim to an episode triggered by her PTSD and is forced to confront her struggles through two strange but poignant interactions with strangers.
